 Order
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner Binayak Dandasena has filed this writ petition with a prayer to quash the impugned order dated 28.04.2023 passed in Misc. Case No.31 of 2023 by the Collector, Kalahandi, (opp. party no.4) and for a direction to the opp. party no.4 for payment of one-time cash compensation as per his eligibility under Para 8(3) of the Odisha Resettlement & Rehabilitation Policy, 2006 and also payment of the deficit amount of compensation of land of Rs.1,14,429/- along with solation and interest as applicable under Land Acquisition Act, 1984 in pursuance of resolution adopted in the Special Grama- Sabha meeting dated 06.10.2004.

Learned counsel for the petitioner placed the paragraphs no.10 and 11 of the writ petition wherein it is stated that in view of the percentage of land acquired, the petitioner is eligible to get benefits of one-time cash compensation in pursuance of Resettlement & Rehabilitation Policy, 2006 against Binayak Dandasena vs State Of Odisha And on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53506537/
1 which only Rs.50,000/- was awarded to the petitioner on 31.03.2010 after lapse of more than four years of land acquisition which is illegal in the eye of law.
It is further contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that in view of Odisha Resettlement and Rehabilitation Policy, 2006 and since the petitioner's family comes under the category of (iv)
and (v), one- time cash assistance of Rs.1,00,000/- is required to be paid, but the same has not been done in the case of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Issue notice to the opposite parties indicating therein that the matter shall be disposed of at the stage of admission.
Learned counsel for the State accepted the notice on behalf of the opp. party no. 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6.

Five extra copies of the writ petition along with enclosures be served on the learned counsel for the State,
who is appearing for opposite parties 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 within a week.
Requisites for issuance of notice to the opp. party no.3 by speed post with proof of delivery shall be filed within one week with proper address.
List this matter in the week commencing from 17.02.2025.
Counter, if any, may be filed in the meantime.
